name: nexoraldns-tests
description: Test suites for NexoralDNS (server, tools, dhcp, web). Fully mocked infra (Mongo/Redis/RabbitMQ) — CI/CD-ready, needs no real services.

scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:tools && npm run test:dhcp && npm run test:web
scripts.coverage:web: cd ../Web && go test -v -count=1 -coverprofile=coverage.out ./... && go tool cover -func=coverage.out && rm coverage.out
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage:server && npm run coverage:tools && npm run coverage:dhcp && npm run coverage:web
